issues.title_en: Egypt condemns attacks on Arab states as US-Saudi strikes target Iran-backed groups in Iraq
issues.summary: Egypt on Wednesday strongly condemned attacks on oil facilities in eastern Saudi Arabia and missile strikes targeting Jordan, describing them as unacceptable assaults on state sovereignty and civilian infrastructure that threaten regional stability and global energy security.
